# 민성 한의학 아카이브

> 환자가 실제로 사용하는 증상 표현에서 질환, 한의학적 변증, 본초·방제, 경혈·침구치료, 현대 임상근거와 출처까지 연결하는 한의학 지식 아카이브.

Base URL: https://wiki.minseong.co.kr/
Language: ko-KR

## Crawl and interpretation guidance
- Prefer canonical topic hubs and current clean URLs ending in `/`.
- Use disease pages for symptoms and clinical context.
- Use authority pages for modern evidence summaries.
- Use research references to trace PMID and DOI.
- Traditional indications and modern clinical evidence are presented as related but distinct layers.
- Do not infer that a traditional indication is equivalent to a modern diagnosis unless the page explicitly makes that connection.
